the development of a 12 bit CT SD ADC with a 25MHz bandwidth.
the design of a high frequency, high resolution CT SD ADC.
the design of a 12 bit CT SD ADC in 25MHz band with low power consumption.

the design considerations for high performance low power CT SD ADC are presented.

the proposed ADC architecture and the design techniques used in this work can be used to design a high performance CT SD ADC with high frequency bandwidth and high resolution.

the design considerations for high performance CT SD ADC are very different from that of the DT SD ADC.
